page.notes: This is the e-rara.ch digitisation cover sheet, not a page of the printed book. Its banner, logo, title block (Turrettini, Disputatio theologica de sacramentis in genere, Genevae 1620, shelf mark Bf 880 (12)), persistent link, terms of use and Visual Library logo are the digitiser's own material and are left out of the transcription as instructed. The printed book's title page would be the next scan.
